AMENDMENT TEXT

Act No. 21065 (October 1, 2025)

Act Partially Amending the Government Organization Act

[Main body omitted]

ADDENDA

Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided, among the Acts amended pursuant to Article 7 of the Addenda, the portions amending Acts promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose enforcement dates have not yet arrived shall each enter into force on the enforcement date of the relevant Act ... <Omitted> ...

1. and 2. Omitted.

Articles 2 through 6 Omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to other Acts)
(1) through (337) Omitted.

(338) The Act on the Management of Zoos and Aquariums is partially amended as follows:

In Article 5 (1) and (3); the portion of Article 6 (1) preceding the subparagraphs, and paragraphs (2) and (3) of that Article; the portion of Article 7 (1) preceding the subparagraphs; Article 8 (2) and (3); the first sentence of the portion of Article 12 (1) preceding the subparagraphs; Article 14 (1); Article 16 (3); Article 17 (3); Article 22 (1); the portion of Article 24 (1) preceding the subparagraphs, paragraph (2) of that Article, and the main clause of the portion of paragraph (3) of that Article preceding the subparagraphs; and Article 28 (1) and (2), "Minister of Environment" is replaced by "Minister of Climate, Energy and Environment" in each instance.

In the portion of Article 6 (1) preceding the subparagraphs and paragraph (4) of that Article; the portion of Article 7 (1) preceding the subparagraphs; Article 10 (3); Article 13 (1), (3), and (6); Article 14 (2); Article 15 (1) 3 (b) and (2); Article 17 (2) 3; Article 18 (2); the portion of Article 19 (1) preceding the subparagraphs and paragraph (3) of that Article; subparagraph 4 of Article 20; Article 22 (4); Article 24 (4); and Article 26 (2), "Ministry of Environment" is replaced by "Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment" in each instance.

(339) through (626) Omitted.

Article 8 Omitted.

REASONS FOR ENACTMENT OR AMENDMENT

[Partial amendment]

Reasons for amendment

This amendment redesigns the government organizational structure to disperse and reallocate functions and powers concentrated in certain ministries, address concerns about the concentration of authority, strengthen the expertise specific to each function, and respond proactively to changes in the administrative environment, including the climate crisis and the transition driven by artificial intelligence. It also reorganizes the deputy prime minister system and the system of ministries and agencies under the Prime Minister to strengthen capabilities in science and technology, artificial intelligence, national data, and intellectual property administration, and strengthens government functions to actively pursue gender equality policies and occupational safety and health policies.

Main provisions

(a) The Korea Communications Commission is abolished and the Broadcasting, Media and Communications Commission is established. Broadcasting promotion functions performed by the Ministry of Science and ICT are transferred to the Broadcasting, Media and Communications Commission (Article 2 (2) 1 and Article 31).

(b) Two Deputy Prime Ministers are provided to oversee and coordinate economic policy and science, technology, and artificial intelligence policy. The Minister of Finance and Economy and the Minister of Science and ICT concurrently serve in those positions, respectively, while the Deputy Prime Minister position concurrently held by the Minister of Education is abolished (Article 19).

(c) To secure checks and balances between budgetary and economic functions and strengthen the expertise of each function, the Ministry of Economy and Finance is divided into the Ministry of Planning and Budget under the Prime Minister and the Ministry of Finance and Economy (newly inserted Article 23 and Article 30).

(d) Statistics Korea and the Korean Intellectual Property Office are elevated to the National Data Office and the Ministry of Intellectual Property, respectively, under the Prime Minister (newly inserted Articles 27 and 28).

(e) The order of executive ministries is adjusted to reflect the reorganization of the Deputy Prime Ministers and executive ministries. Two Vice Ministers are provided in each of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment and the Ministry of SMEs and Startups (Article 29).

(f) To establish a system of mutual checks between investigative and prosecutorial agencies, the Prosecutors' Office is abolished. A Public Prosecution Office under the Minister of Justice and a Serious Crime Investigation Office under the Minister of the Interior and Safety are each established (Articles 35 and 37).

(g) The Ministry of Environment is reorganized as the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment. Energy functions of the former Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy, excluding the export of nuclear power generation, are transferred to the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment to pursue environmental, climate change, and energy policies in a coordinated and integrated manner. Reflecting the transfer of energy functions, the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy is reorganized as the Ministry of Trade and Industry (Articles 41 and 43).

(h) The Ministry of Employment and Labor is provided with one headquarters head responsible for occupational safety and health functions, serving as a political appointee (newly inserted Article 44 (2)).

(i) To comprehensively pursue gender equality policies, the Ministry of Women and Family (Yeoseong Gajokbu) is renamed the Ministry of Gender Equality and Family (Seongpyeongdeung Gajokbu), and is expanded and reorganized, including the transfer of some relevant functions from the Ministry of Employment and Labor (Article 45 and Article 2 (1) of the Addenda).
